title: Family Matters: Language Transfer and Merging for Adapting Small LLMs to Faroese
abstract: arXiv:2510.00810v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this paper, we investigate strategies for adapting small language models to Faroese, a low-resource North Germanic language. Starting from English-pretrained models, we first continue pre-training on other Scandinavian languages, either individually or combined via model merging or multilingual pre-training, before fine-tuning on Faroese. To address the lack of existing Faroese evaluation resources, we construct two new minimal-pair probing benchmarks, one for linguistic acceptability and one for text comprehension, and complement them with human evaluations conducted by native Faroese linguists. Our results show that transfer from related languages improves language modeling and linguistic acceptability, while gains on comprehension probes are inconsistent across model sizes and tuning methods. Icelandic is the strongest single source language for linguistic acceptability, but no single language is reliably best for comprehension

translated_title: 家族很重要：面向法罗语的小型语言模型适配的语言迁移与模型合并
translated_abstract: 本文研究了将小型语言模型适配到法罗语（Faroese，一种低资源的北日耳曼语言）的策略。研究者从英语预训练模型出发，先在其他斯堪的纳维亚语言上进行继续预训练——可以是单独使用某一种语言，也可以通过模型合并或多语言预训练的方式组合使用——然后再在法罗语上进行微调。针对现有法罗语评估资源匮乏的问题，作者构建了两个新的最小对探针基准：一个用于语言可接受性测试，另一个用于文本理解测试，并由母语法罗语的语言学家进行人工评估加以补充。结果表明，来自相关语言的迁移能够提升语言建模和语言可接受性，但在文本理解探针上的收益在不同模型规模和调优方法下表现并不一致。冰岛语是语言可接受性方面最强的单一源语言，但没有哪一种语言在理解任务上能够稳定地表现最优。
tldr: 该论文的核心贡献是通过先在斯堪的纳维亚亲缘语言上继续预训练再适配法罗语，并构建两个全新的法罗语最小对探针评估基准，证明了语言家族内的迁移能有效提升低资源语言的语言建模与可接受性。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that continuing pre-training on related Scandinavian languages before adapting to Faroese, along with two newly constructed minimal-pair probing benchmarks, effectively improves language modeling and linguistic acceptability for low-resource languages through intra-family language transfer.
